Implemented the integration changes:
- Improved duplicate-value mapping and ordered multi-dict behavior.
- Added warning-free argument formatting; verified keyword-only defaults.
- Fixed reverse set subtraction and difference updates.
- Added glom modes, bindings, and streaming specs; fixed nested inspection.
- Wrote requirement confidence estimates to `STATUS.json`.

Validation: 162 focused tests passed, plus API smoke checks and 40,000 randomized multi-dict checks. Three legacy Python/PyYAML compatibility failures remain; full-suite collection is blocked by removed `pprint._safe_repr`. No tests or packaging configuration were changed.
